name: v17.15.0
body:
SchemaCrawler  release at last commit b461409dc487900fffb55914234715a940dde836
See the change history at https://www.schemacrawler.com/changes-report.html


## What's Changed
* Bump github/codeql-action from 4.37.7 to 4.37.8 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2463
* Move table importance record creation into a utility by @sualeh in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2464
* Add a module to verify the exported packages from SchemaCrawler Core by @sualeh in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2465
* Move plugin registry into utilities, so that the JDBC registry can use the base functionality by @sualeh in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2466
* Rewrite JDBC URL tokenizer with more real world tests, for better fingerprinting by @sualeh in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2475
* Bump org.graalvm.polyglot:python from 25.2.4 to 25.3.4.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2467
* Bump com.ing.data:cassandra-jdbc-wrapper from 5.0.2 to 5.0.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2468
* Bump org.freemarker:freemarker from 2.3.34 to 2.3.35 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2469
* Bump org.graalvm.polyglot:js from 25.2.4 to 25.3.4.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2470
* Bump github/codeql-action from 4.37.8 to 4.37.9 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2472
* Bump org.graalvm.polyglot:polyglot from 25.2.4 to 25.3.4.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2471
* Bump chainguard-dev/actions/setup-gitsign from 1.6.32 to 1.6.33 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2473
* Bump actions/setup-java from 5 to 6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2474
* Reorganize utility classes by @sualeh in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2476
* Add new importance command based on the schema graph model by @sualeh in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2477
* Add column attributes counts by @sualeh in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2478
* Add importance score by @sualeh in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2479
* Add max tables parameter by @sualeh in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2480
* Add cluster detection by @sualeh in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2481
* Create complete public API for the importance model by @sualeh in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2483
* Next release by @sualeh in https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/pull/2484


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/schemacrawler/SchemaCrawler/compare/v17.14.1...v17.15.0
